property_summary: C.transfer always reverts unless it is called by 0x9797055B...; since the test contract is the caller, transfer must revert for every input.
C.transfer always reverts when the destination array is empty, for any caller.
For any non-empty recipient list, C.transfer reverts (and leaves state untouched) because the caller is not the authorized address 0x9797055B68C5DadDE6b3c7d5D80C9CFE2eecE6c9.
C.transfer always reverts when called by anyone other than the authorized address, so a call from this test contract must revert for any input.
A transfer attempt never changes C's public state: from and caddress keep their fixed values regardless of input (and the call reverts for an unauthorized caller).
compiler_error: a state-changing call on c is not a plain top-level statement, or c is reached through a low-level call / abi.encodeWithSignature / address cast / interface / helper. Every call must be `c.f(args);`, `x = c.f(args);`, or `try c.f(args) { ... } catch { ... }` at top level of the single public function; only view calls may sit inside require/assert

property_summary: c.transfer always reverts when invoked by any caller other than 0x9797055B68C5DadDE6b3c7d5D80C9CFE2eecE6c9, regardless of inputs, and leaves c's Ether balance unchanged.
Any call to c.transfer by the test contract reverts and leaves c's Ether balance unchanged.
Invoking c.transfer never changes the public state variables from or caddress, regardless of whether it succeeds or reverts.
The public getters from() and caddress() always return the fixed deployment-time addresses, regardless of any parameters.
Any call to c.transfer reverts unless msg.sender is the fixed authorized address, which the test contract never is; so transfer must revert for all inputs.
For any input arrays, c.transfer always reverts (the caller is never the fixed authorized address), regardless of array contents or lengths.
For any arrays of bounded length, c.transfer reverts when called by anyone other than the fixed authorized address (the test contract), returning no value and changing nothing.
